## read in packages and data

```{r}
#packages 
library(tidyverse)

#read in data
sensors <- read_csv("../Data/sensors_joined.csv") 
 

###filter depths from 0.1 meter resolution for easier plotting viz to 1 meter intervals
high_res_sites <- c(50, 88, 90)   # example — replace with your actual 3 sites

sensors_filt <- sensors %>%
  group_by(Site, Date) %>%
  mutate(max_depth = max(Depth_m, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(
    # keep all depths for non–high-res sites
    !Site %in% high_res_sites |
    
    # for high-res sites, keep:
    Depth_m == 0.1 |                # the 0.1 m depth
   # Depth_m %% 1 == 0 |             # whole meters (1,2,3,...)
    Depth_m %% 0.5 == 0 |          # half meter intervals 
    Depth_m == max_depth            # the actual deepest measurement
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


```


## Make levels for plotting 

```{r}
### Date levels for plotting
levels_db <- c("22 May", "19 Jun", "11 Jul", "14 Aug", "16 Sep", 
               "30 Sep", "28 Oct", "17 Dec", "26 Feb", "16 Apr")


## set axis break levels for different subsets
#S1 to C1
x_breaks_list_S1_C1 <- c(0, 150, 300)
y_breaks_list_S1_C1 <- c(0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5)

#s1 to P2
x_breaks_list_S1_P2 <- c(0, 600, 1200)
y_breaks_list_S1_P2 <- c(0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21)



```





## Plot just sensor data

```{r}

plot_sensors <- function(df,
                     fill_var = NULL,
                     fill_var_label = NULL,
                     Sites = NULL,
                     X_breaks = NULL,
                     Y_breaks = NULL,
                     point_outline = "black",    # any color or "transparent"
                     show_depth_line = TRUE,      # brown max depth line
                     show_water_line = TRUE       # blue y = 0 line
                     ) {     
  
  p <- df %>%
    filter(Site_code %in% Sites) %>%
    mutate(
      Dry_start = ifelse(Depth_m == 0.1 & Site_code == "S1", Dry_start, NA),
      Dry_end   = ifelse(Depth_m == 0.1 & Site_code == "S1", Dry_end, NA),
      Date1     = format(Date, "%d %b")
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Distance, y = Depth_m, fill = {{ fill_var }} )) +
      geom_rect(aes(xmin = Dry_start, xmax = Dry_end,
                    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
                alpha = 1, fill = "gray", color = NA)

  if (show_water_line) p <- p + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "blue")
  if (show_depth_line) p <- p + geom_line(aes(y = Max_Depth_Site_m + 0.1),
                                           size = 1, color = "#654321")

  p <- p +
      geom_point(size = 3, shape = 21, color = point_outline) +
      facet_wrap(~factor(Date1, levels = levels_db), nrow = 1) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "top",
        text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      ) +
      labs(
        x = "Distance from Stream (m)",
        y = "Depth (m)",
        fill = fill_var_label
      ) +
      scale_y_reverse(breaks = Y_breaks) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = X_breaks) +
      scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Spectral", direction = -1)

  p
  
} #end of function


```


 
Use function to plot sensors S1 to C1

```{r}

## TEMP
s1_c1_temp <- plot_sensors(
  df = sensors_filt,
  fill_var = Temp_C,
  fill_var_label = "Temp (C)",
  Sites = c("S1", "S2", "B1", "B2", "C1"),
  X_breaks = x_breaks_list_S1_C1,
  Y_breaks = y_breaks_list_S1_C1)

## DO
s1_c1_do <- plot_sensors( df = sensors_filt,
  fill_var = DOsat_percent,  fill_var_label = "DO (%sat)",
  Sites = c("S1", "S2", "B1", "B2", "C1"),  X_breaks = x_breaks_list_S1_C1,  Y_breaks = y_breaks_list_S1_C1)

## SC
s1_c1_sc <- plot_sensors( df = sensors_filt,
  fill_var = SpCond_uScm,  fill_var_label = expression(paste("SC (",mu,"S/cm)")),
  Sites = c("S1", "S2", "B1", "B2", "C1"),  X_breaks = x_breaks_list_S1_C1,  Y_breaks = y_breaks_list_S1_C1)



#### stack for SI
sensors_S1_C1 <- cowplot::plot_grid(s1_c1_temp, s1_c1_sc, s1_c1_do, labels = c("a", "b", "c"), ncol = 1)
sensors_S1_C1
#ggsave("../Figures/FigS6_sensors_S1_C1.png", sensors_S1_C1, width = 11, height = 8, units = "in")

```

 
 Use function to plot sensors S1 to P2

```{r}

## TEMP
s1_p2_temp <- plot_sensors(
  df = sensors_filt,
  fill_var = Temp_C,
  fill_var_label = "Temp (C)",
  Sites = c("S1", "S2", "B1", "B2", "C1", "C2", "P1", "P2"),
  X_breaks = x_breaks_list_S1_P2,
  Y_breaks = y_breaks_list_S1_P2,
  point_outline = "transparent", show_depth_line = F, show_water_line = F)

##DO
s1_p2_do <- plot_sensors(df = sensors_filt,
  fill_var = DOsat_percent,  fill_var_label = "DO (%sat)",
  Sites = c("S1", "S2", "B1", "B2", "C1", "C2", "P1", "P2"), 
  X_breaks = x_breaks_list_S1_P2,  Y_breaks = y_breaks_list_S1_P2,  
  point_outline = "transparent", show_depth_line = F, show_water_line = F)

##SC
s1_p2_sc <- plot_sensors(df = sensors_filt,
  fill_var = SpCond_uScm,  fill_var_label = expression(paste("SC (",mu,"S/cm)")),
  Sites = c("S1", "S2", "B1", "B2", "C1", "C2", "P1", "P2"), 
  X_breaks = x_breaks_list_S1_P2,  Y_breaks = y_breaks_list_S1_P2,  
  point_outline = "transparent", show_depth_line = F, show_water_line = F)

## stack for SI
sensors_S1_P2 <- cowplot::plot_grid(s1_p2_temp, s1_p2_sc, s1_p2_do, labels = c("a", "b", "c"), ncol = 1)

sensors_S1_P2

#ggsave("../Figures/figS5_sensors_S1_P2.png", sensors_S1_P2, width = 11, height = 8, units = "in")

```

##some summary stats

```{r}
sensors_filt |> group_by(Site) |> 
  summarise(DO_min = min(DOsat_percent),
            SC_mean = mean(SpCond_uScm),
            SC_min = min(SpCond_uScm),
            SC_max = max(SpCond_uScm))
```
